# Arpente

> Arpente is a free journal of walks and hikes for iPhone, in French and English. It records each exploration with GPS, draws it on a map, and keeps its distance, duration, elevation gain, notes and photos. It isn't a performance app: no rankings, no feed, no followers. No account, no ads: your routes are stored on your iPhone and in your private iCloud. Made by Wibeset in Canada.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone only (not available on Android or the web). Coming soon to the App Store.
- Languages: the app is in English and French. This website is in English, French and Spanish.
- Price: free, with no ads, no subscription and no account.
- Idea: a journal of explorations rather than a fitness tracker. A 2 km walk around the block and an 18 km hike in the mountains are both worth keeping.
- Privacy: routes, locations, notes and photos are stored on the device and synced with the user's private iCloud; the developer never receives them. Location is used only while recording.
- Maps: Apple Maps.
- Statistics: distance, duration and elevation gain, by month and by year, plus a map of every place explored.
- Export: each route as a GPX file.

- [Acropole des Draveurs](https://arpente.app/quebec-hikes/acropole-des-draveurs/): Hiking the Acropole des Draveurs in Parc national des Hautes-Gorges-de-la-Rivière-Malbaie: about 10.4 km return, 800 m of climbing. Map, photos and tips.
- [Sentier de la Statue](https://arpente.app/quebec-hikes/sentier-de-la-statue/): Hiking the Sentier de la Statue from Baie-Éternité, high above the Saguenay Fjord: about 7.6 km return. Map, elevation profile, photos and tips.
- [Lachine Canal](https://arpente.app/montreal-walks/lachine-canal/): Walking the Lachine Canal path in Montréal, from the Old Port to Lachine: 14.5 km, flat, past locks, old factories and Atwater Market. Map, photos and tips.
- [Mount Royal](https://arpente.app/montreal-walks/mount-royal/): Walking up Mount Royal from the top of rue Peel: about 1.4 km to the Kondiaronk lookout, 2 km to the cross, 150 m of climbing. Map, profile, photos and tips.
